q1.question: What is the free assessment and what do I get?
q1.answer: A quick review of your website and tools to see what's worth solving. Within 24 business hours we send you three findings, the size of project you most likely need and the next step. It's free, with no commitment.

q2.question: What does the assessment not include?
q2.answer: The assessment tells you what to do first and why. Price and scope come later, in the proposal, because they depend on what we decide together. We work with what's visible from the outside and what you tell us, so we don't need access to your systems. If a deeper review is needed, we tell you what it includes and what it costs.

q3.question: What happens after the assessment?
q3.answer: If you want to move forward, we book a 30-minute call to understand how you operate. Then we send you a written proposal within 5 business days, with scope, timeline and cost. The project starts once we sign the contract and the confidentiality agreement, and receive the deposit.

q4.question: Do I need to know about technology to work with you?
q4.answer: No. You tell us how your business works and we translate it into the technical solution. We explain every decision in plain words, and you approve every screen.

q5.question: What kind of businesses do you work with?
q5.answer: We focus on solving what your business needs, whatever industry it comes from. We work with companies, real estate firms, hotels, schools, distributors, startups, entrepreneurs and personal brands, and with any business that has a process it wants to solve or improve with technology.

q1.question: How much does a project cost?
q1.answer: It depends on what your business needs. We don't sell fixed packages: we quote only what you need. If something technical requires a service you hadn't planned for, we suggest it with its pros and cons, and you decide. The cost is in writing in the proposal, before we start.

q2.question: How do I pay for a project?
q2.answer: With a deposit to get started and the rest as agreed in the proposal.

q3.question: What if my budget doesn't cover everything?
q3.answer: We adjust the scope and protect the quality. We can start with what has the most impact and split the project into phases, so you move forward without paying for everything at once.

q4.question: Which costs are separate?
q4.answer: Hosting, your domain, licenses and the usage of AI or automation tools are contracted directly by you, so the accounts are always yours. If you add marketing, ad spend is also paid directly to the platforms, with a budget we agree on together. All of this is listed in the proposal.

q5.question: Which services are quoted separately?
q5.answer: Support after launch, creative content (photo, video and graphic pieces) and marketing. They're optional: you add them only if your business needs them, and each one is quoted separately from the project.

q1.question: How long does a project take?
q1.answer: It depends on the scope. The timeline for each stage is in writing in the proposal, and if anything changes it, we let you know in advance.

q2.question: How do I know how my project is going?
q2.answer: Our team is with you from start to finish. A project manager runs your project day to day and is your point of contact for progress, deliveries and questions. An account manager advises you from the assessment and proposal onward, and looks after your account whenever you need something new. We work in stages, you see the progress in each one, and nothing moves forward without your approval.

q3.question: Can I ask for changes during the project?
q3.answer: Yes. That's why you approve every screen before we build it: early on, changes cost less. If a change goes beyond the agreed scope, we tell you how much time and cost it adds before doing it, and you decide.

q4.question: Do you work with clients outside your city or Mexico?
q4.answer: Yes. We work remotely with clients in any country, with a team in Mexico, the United States and Europe. We invoice and quote in the currency we agree on.

q1.question: Who owns what you build?
q1.answer: You do. We hand everything over documented, and the accounts your system runs on are in your name from day one, so you never depend on a single person.

q2.question: What happens after launch?
q2.answer: We launch with you and train your team to use it. If you want us to keep taking care of it, support is quoted separately.

q3.question: Do you sign a confidentiality agreement? How do you protect my information?
q3.answer: Yes. We sign a confidentiality agreement before you share any internal information. We access your systems with only the access we need, and we handle your data as described in our {privacy}.

q1.question: How do I join the talent pool?
q1.answer: Fill out the form on the {about} page with your area, portfolio and CV. We review your profile and add you to the talent pool by industry and by project.

q2.question: When will you contact me?
q2.answer: When there's a project that fits you; the timing depends on the projects that come in. We keep your CV for one year. If you'd like us to delete it sooner, write to {email}.

q3.question: Do I have to work full time or from a set location?
q3.answer: No. You choose which projects you join, who you work with and where you work from. We all work by the same rules and the same delivery standard.

controller.nav: Who is responsible for your data
controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
controller.body: Roberto Mirón Nájera, an individual operating under the trade name muush ("muush" or "we"), located at Del Puente #11, San Bartolo Ameyalco, Álvaro Obregón, 01800, Mexico City, Mexico, is responsible for processing your personal data. For any privacy matter, write to support{'@'}muush.dev.

data.title: What data we collect

assessment.data: Name, email, company or project, how you identify, your website or social media, what you need, preferred contact method and, if you choose WhatsApp, your number.

application.data: Name, email, area and role, portfolio link, LinkedIn link, CV in PDF, preferred contact method and, if you choose WhatsApp, your number.

call.data: Name, email and the time you choose, through Cal.com.

browsing.data: IP address, browser, pages visited, cookie identifiers and actions on the site.

data.sensitive: We don't ask for sensitive personal data. A CV may include it without us asking, such as health status, religious beliefs or union membership. Please leave it out. If your CV includes it, we use it only to evaluate your profile and with your express consent, which you give by ticking the box on the form.

purposes.title: What we use it for
purposes.intro: We use your data for these purposes, which we need to handle what you asked for:

items.assessment: If you requested an assessment: to answer your request, contact you the way you chose, prepare your assessment and a proposal and, if we work together, manage the business relationship and invoicing.
items.application: If you applied through Work with muush: to evaluate your profile with your express consent, contact you for an interview and invite you to projects that fit for as long as we keep your CV.
items.both: In both cases: to send you the automatic email confirming we received your information.

purposes.additionalIntro: We also use your data for two additional purposes, which we don't need to handle your request and which only apply if you accept them in the cookie notice:

additionalItems.analytics: Measuring how the site is used: we use Google Analytics to see how many people visit, how they find us, which sections they read and at which step of the forms they stop. We don't send it your name, email, phone or anything you write in the forms.
additionalItems.advertising: Measuring and showing advertising: we use Meta Pixel to see how our ads perform and to show muush ads to people who visited the site. If you request an assessment, we also send Meta your email and, if you chose WhatsApp, your phone number, to learn whether your request came from an ad. Before they leave your browser, the pixel turns them into an irreversible code (a hash), so Meta does not receive them as typed.

purposes.objection: You can object to these purposes at any time, as explained in Cookies and pixels. Apart from the email and phone mentioned above, we don't use what you write in the forms for measurement or advertising, and never your CV or your Work with muush application.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.intro: We don't sell your data. We only share it with:

items.providers: The providers that help us operate: Amazon Web Services (site hosting), Amazon SES (email delivery), Google Drive (CV storage), Notion (records of requests and applications) and Cal.com (call scheduling). They process your data on our behalf, under our instructions and under confidentiality. Some have servers outside Mexico.
items.meta: Meta Platforms, which receives browsing data through its pixel to measure and show ads and, if you accepted advertising and request an assessment, your email and phone number as a hash.
items.google: Google, which receives browsing data through Google Analytics to measure how the site is used, only if you accepted analytics.
items.collaborators: muush collaborators working on your project, only the data they need and under a confidentiality agreement. Some may be outside Mexico.
items.authorities: Authorities, when a law requires it.

sharing.talentPool: Your talent pool profile and CV stay at muush: we don't share them with partners or other companies.
sharing.transfers: Except for what is stated about Meta and Google, we don't make any data transfers that require your consent.

retention.title: How long we keep it

items.cv: Your CV and talent pool profile: 1 year from when we receive them. When that period ends, we delete them.
items.requests: Assessment requests that don't move forward: 12 months from the last contact.
items.clients: Clients: for the length of the relationship and, after that, the period required by tax law.
items.browsing: Browsing, analytics and pixel data: up to 14 months.

retention.earlyDeletion: You can ask us to delete it sooner at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: You have the right to access, rectify or update, cancel or object to the use of your data (known in Mexico as ARCO rights). You can also object to decisions made solely by automated means; we don't make any today.
rights.howTo: To exercise them, email support{'@'}muush.dev with the subject "ARCO rights" and include:

steps.contact: Your name and the email where you want our reply.
steps.identification: A copy of your official ID. If someone represents you, their ID and the document that proves it.
steps.request: Which data and which right you want to exercise. For a correction, the correct data.
steps.documents: Any document that helps us find your data.

rights.response: We reply within 20 business days at most. If your request is valid, we carry it out within the following 15 business days. It's free.

withdrawal.title: How to withdraw consent or limit the use of your data
withdrawal.body: Email support{'@'}muush.dev with the subject "Withdraw consent" or "Limit use of my data", with the same details as for ARCO rights. Without your data, we may not be able to keep handling your request or your application.

cookies.title: Cookies and pixels
cookies.body: muush.dev uses the technical cookies it needs to work, for example to remember your language and your cookie choice. The rest fall into two categories you accept separately: Analytics, with Google Analytics, to measure visits (the _ga and _ga_* cookies, which last up to 14 months), and Advertising, with Meta Pixel, to measure and show ads (the _fbp cookie, which lasts 90 days). These technologies collect your IP address, browser, pages visited and cookie identifiers.
cookies.choices: You can accept or decline them in the site's cookie notice and change your choice here at any time. Your choice lasts 12 months; after that we ask again. If you withdraw your permission, we stop using them and delete their cookies from muush.dev. You can also turn them off in your browser settings or in your Meta account's ad preferences.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.body: We publish any change on this page, with its update date at the top. If a change requires your consent, we'll ask for it by email.

authority.title: Authority
authority.body: If you believe your data protection rights were violated, you can go to Mexico's Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno, the data protection authority since March 2025.

usingTheSite.title: Using this site
usingTheSite.body: These terms apply to your use of muush.dev. By browsing the site or sending a form, you accept them. If you don't agree with them, please don't use the site.

whatYouFind.title: What you'll find here
whatYouFind.body: Information about our services, forms to request an assessment or apply to our talent pool, and links to write to us or book a call. This site doesn't sell products or take payments.

items.review: It includes a review of your website and tools, what to do first and why. If you need to go deeper, we tell you what it includes and what it costs, and that is quoted separately.
items.free: It's free and doesn't commit you to hiring us.
items.response: We reply within 24 business hours through the channel you chose.
items.guidance: It's general guidance based on what you share with us. Decisions about your business are yours, and the assessment doesn't replace legal, tax or financial advice.

projects.title: Projects and proposals
projects.body: The content of this site is informational and isn't a binding offer. Each project is governed by its accepted proposal and signed contract, which prevail over anything on this site.

workWithUs.title: Work with muush
workWithUs.body: Applying to our talent pool doesn't create an employment relationship or guarantee that you'll join a project. Every collaboration is agreed in writing before it starts, with clear scope, timing and pay. By applying, you confirm that the information you send is true and that you're allowed to share it.

properUse.title: Proper use of the site
properUse.body: Use the site lawfully and with truthful information. Please don't impersonate anyone, try to access non-public areas, disrupt the site, introduce malicious code or extract its content automatically.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: The text, design, logos, animations and code on this site belong to muush or their respective owners and are protected by law. You can view them and share links to the site. For any other use, ask us for written permission.
intellectualProperty.submissions: What you send us remains yours. You allow us to use it only to handle your request or application.

thirdParties.title: Third-party sites
thirdParties.body: The site links to third-party services such as Cal.com, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Instagram. Each has its own terms and notices, and muush doesn't control them.

availability.title: Availability and liability
availability.body: We work to keep the site available and its information up to date. It may change or be interrupted, for example for maintenance.
availability.liability: To the extent the law allows, muush isn't liable for indirect damages arising from use of the site or from decisions based only on its content. None of this limits the rights the law gives you as a consumer.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
privacy.body: We handle your data as explained in our privacy notice, where you can also change your cookie preferences.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We publish any change on this page, with its update date at the top. Changes apply from the moment they are published.

governingLaw.title: Governing law
governingLaw.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Mexico. Any dispute is resolved before the courts of Mexico City. If you're a consumer, you can also go to Mexico's Federal Consumer Protection Agency (Profeco).

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any question about these terms, write to support{'@'}muush.dev.
